code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Each isolated signal cell radiates its color along its row until a boundary stripe.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==8:
                # radiate the signal horizontally; retain 1 boundary cells
                g[r][c]=4
                for j in range(c-1,-1,-1):
                    if grid[r][j]==1: break
                    g[r][j]=8
                for j in range(c+1,w):
                    if grid[r][j]==1: break
                    g[r][j]=8
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
